prompt: Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
